column1: # status.governance.tsv — merged from the two half-assessments of section `governance`.
# The halves were written as status.governance-vaults.tsv and status.governance-account.tsv.
# apply-status.mjs derives the SECTION from the filename, so those two names resolved to
# sections 'governance-vaults' and 'governance-account', neither of which exists — 121 rows
# of completed assessment sat unapplied. Merged here under the real section name.

column5: 1VH crop of 5243-69438, same design. Earn is routed at App.tsx:1119 and its 5 tabs (opportunities/positions/vaults/faucet/referral) match the frame's sub-nav exactly. HELD PARTIAL for the opportunities surface itself: the frame draws a 10-row TABLE with columns Pool / Fee / APY / TVL / Risk / Volume (1W) / My position / Action; the app renders a category-filter row plus a stack of OpportunityCard components. Two of those columns have no source at all — EarnOpportunity (src/hooks/defi/useEarnData.ts:140-175) has no `fee` and no 1-week volume field, and the pool rows the frame lists (SKAI/USDC aggressive, SKAI/BNB low-risk, SKAI/USDC conservative) are AMM pairs on the venue that is empty. So the table is not a layout change, it is a data gap. The hero copy "Let your crypto work for you!" and its second line are verbatim frame text and are not in the app.

Full-scroll twin of 5220-10996 — identical content plus the Skai wordmark footer (Home/Help/Terms/Privacy) and the price ticker. Same verdict and same reason: tabs and route are right, the opportunities TABLE with Fee and Volume (1W) is not built and two of its columns have no backing field. The footer and ticker are app-wide furniture already shipped elsewhere, not page work.

MEASURED 2026-09-06 at all three boards it is drawn at (10517-38187 / 11972-151493 / 12003-383100). Frame 271 is space-between on 6/16 padding; cluster gutter 8 at 375 and 16 above it; the current-page control is 40/42/42 high on 12/20 padding, 8px radius, 14px label; 'Pages' and the range readout are 12 on every board. The readout '1 - 10 of 12' fixes the page size at 10, which is also why the plain 5243-69438 draws no pager - the control only appears above a single page. Every control carries no-min-size because index.css:746-753 floors buttons at 44px under max-width:768, which covers the 768 board too. A filter change resets to page 1. Oracle: src/pages/defi/__tests__/EarnPager.figma.test.tsx, 23 assertions, 16 of them red against the pre-fix values. HELD PARTIAL because the REST of this frame is 5243-69438, whose opportunities TABLE (Fee and Volume (1W) columns) still has no backing field - see the row above.

Real screen — the Earn table filtered to liquidity pools only (4 rows, SKAI/USDC + SKAI/BNB, Fee 0.02%, APY 10-15.22%, TVL $5.6-9.2M, Volume (1W) $1.42-2.34M, My position "--", Action CTA). Cannot be built honestly: there is no LP-pair model anywhere in the earn stack (EarnOpportunity has no pair, no fee tier, no weekly volume), and SKAI's AMM is the empty venue — the live book is the CLOB. Rendering these rows means inventing pools, fees and volumes. Needs a product decision about whether the AMM ships, not frontend work.

The deposited state of 5243-73398: the same 4-row pool table with My position filled in (100M SKAI on three rows) and the Action CTA widened. Blocked for exactly the same reason as its parent, plus it additionally requires a per-user LP position read that does not exist.

Strong match, and the copy was checked verbatim rather than by eye. VaultSelection is mounted at Earn.tsx:1427 inside the Vaults tab and is also lazily routed. The frame's two cards are built (House vault / Trading vault, APY range, TVL, risk meter, and the "Backs" lists — VaultSelection.tsx:74 and :83 carry "Casino games"/"Sportsbook"/"Prediction markets" and "Perps trading (60%)"/"Spot MM (30%)"/"Token launches (10%)" exactly as drawn), and the frame's 5-row comparison is built at VaultSelection.tsx:410-419 with all five labels and both value columns matching the frame word for word (Expected APY, Risk Level, Variance, Revenue Source "House edge"/"Trading P&L", Loss Scenario "Rare large payouts"/"Market drawdowns"). I read the source; I did not render the page.

Real screen. Top half is built: the positions tab renders PortfolioHeader plus a list of position cards. Real screen — pool detail for a single opportunity: 12-month volume chart, Total value locked with the SKAI/BNB reserve split, Volume 24H, Fee, an Add liquidity CTA, and an "Other opportunities" table underneath. Same blocker as 11135-77182: no LP pair model, no AMM liquidity, no historical volume. This is the most-drawn missing surface in the section (three frames hang off it).

Real screen, and the single largest unbuilt design in this half — a concentrated-liquidity range editor: candlestick price chart with draggable Min price / Max price handles, fee-tier selector (0.1% / 0.5% / 1% / Full range / Custom), dual-token amount entry (USDT + BNB), slippage, and a Slow / Standard / Fast transaction-speed selector. Grep for "add liquidity" across src returns exactly one file, src/components/predict/LPRewards.tsx, which is prediction-market LP and unrelated. Building this means building a Uniswap-v3-style AMM front end against a venue that has no liquidity.

Real screen — "Review Add liquidity summary" confirmation modal (deposit amount 1.99 SKAI, source instrument SKAI/BNB, currently staked, estimated returns after 3 months, APY, estimated completion date, Confirm order). Child of 10852-361479 and blocked by it; a confirmation step cannot exist before the flow it confirms.

Real screen, and the implementation is substantial (1,642 lines) and routed at App.tsx:1532. Confirmed present: the Overview strip (Total TVL / Available Liquidity / Current Exposure / Insurance Fund at TradingVault.tsx:517-520), the depositors and trades-executed counts, the Strategy breakdown block, the five lock plans the frame draws as Flex / Thirty / Ninety / One-eighty / One-year with their bonus, lock and exit rules (TradingVault.tsx:92 onward, carrying chainTier), and the Risk Disclosure section. ★ TWO FRAME DEFECTS THAT MUST NOT BE COPIED: (1) the Strategy breakdown's Main position is literal placeholder copy — "We operate thus: UPDATE THIS CONTENT" — so this frame is a real screen with a scaffolding hole in it, not a spec for that block; (2) the deposit panel reads "Deposit from token: Solana SOL", the amount is denominated in SOL and the CTA says "Deposit SOL", which contradicts the sUSD rail every other vault surface uses. Held partial pending a decision on both.

Real screen, but its ONLY delta against 5280-82910 is a "PnL — Profit and loss chart on this vault" panel: a 12-month line chart with a 1-year timeframe selector and a hover tooltip. That is the same blocker already recorded for 11259-40697 / 11260-123547 and stated in the code itself — src/pages/YieldVaultDetail.tsx:10 says outright that vault contracts do not expose historical values. Everything else on this frame is 5280-82910. (Its quick-amount chips also switch to $100–$1,000 where 5280-82910 uses 0.5–10 SOL, a second sign the two frames disagree about the deposit asset.)

Real screen — pixel-identical to 5280-82910 except for the House labelling (Games / Games played instead of Depositors / Trades executed, and an amber rather than red Risk Disclosure). ★ REACHABILITY PROBLEM, not a build problem: App.tsx:1531 makes /earn/house-vault a redirect to /sports?tab=pool, so the house pool is implemented (SKAIHousePool via BookieDashboard) but lives OUTSIDE the Earn section this frame places it in. Building the frame as drawn would mean a second house-pool surface, so the real question is where it belongs. Carries the same "UPDATE THIS CONTENT" placeholder as its Trading twin, and the frame's own copy leaks: its Additional-details paragraph and its bottom contract label both still say "Trading vault".
Real screen — 5280-86949 plus the same PnL chart panel as 11151-18953, and blocked for the same reason (no historical vault series). Inherits the reachability problem of 5280-86949 on top.

Child of 5243-74665 and unbuilt with it.

Real screen and closely matched. Routed at App.tsx:1536. Built: the header and subtitle (frame "Deposit sUSDC to the on-chain vaults that back every Skai product", code "Deposit sUSD to the on-chain vaults..." at YieldVaults.tsx:63 — the frame's sUSDC is the retired name), the Aggregate TVL / APY range / Insurance coverage stats (YieldVaults.tsx:99-128), the vault card grid over VaultCard, and InsuranceFundHealth as the third card. MISSING, and the two halves have different causes: the "Feed into liquidity pools" artwork banner is plain unbuilt frontend work, whereas the frame's FOURTH stat "Farmers 139" and the "+100K (14%)" delta under Aggregate TVL are backend-blocked — SKAIYieldVault.sol exposes no depositor-count view and no historical TVL, so both figures would have to be invented. The "1 year" selector at top right is the blocked timeframe control again.

Real screen, 1VH crop of 5515-93883. Built: the Withdraw-from-vault / Deposit-to-vault tab pair, the amount field with Max and the available balance, and most of the right rail — Vault overview covering TVL, APY range, Share price, Shares outstanding, Active deposits, Available liquidity and Pending withdrawals (YieldVaultDetail.tsx:322-336) plus Your position. DepositWithdrawPanel already renders the frame's Estimated shares, Share price and "Lockup: Flexible (no lock)" rows. MISSING: the $100/$200/$300/$500/$1,000 quick-amount chips, the "Potential yield (with 6% APY)" row, the "Holdings analysis" button, and the "Fees $2.16" row. ★ THE FEE ROW IS BLOCKED AND THE KNOWN FINDING UNDERSTATES IT: SKAIYieldVault.sol has no fee logic at all — grepping the contract for "fee" returns only a SafeERC20 import and one comment about receiving house-edge revenue. So it is not only the withdraw frame (11259-44415) that draws an unbacked $2.16; the DEPOSIT tab drawn here carries the identical figure. Rendering either fabricates a money number on a money path.

Real screen — the full-scroll twin of 5515-92313, adding an "Other yield vaults" horizontal carousel with prev/next arrows (SKAI yield vault House card + Insurance fund card) and the page footer. Same verdict and same blocked fee row as its 1VH crop; the carousel is the one extra piece of buildable work, and it is unbuilt.

Real screen — the empty state of gauge voting, and the empty state itself IS built: GaugeWeightsTable.tsx:65-69 renders "No gauges yet" verbatim when the active gauge list is empty, and GaugeVoting is routed at App.tsx:1535 with VotingPowerDisplay and BribeRewardsCard mounted alongside. MISSING vs the frame: the empty panel's second line ("Gauges will appear here once governance registers them") and its "Deposit to vault" CTA, and the right rail's 4-tile "Gauge voting overview" grid (Staked SKAI, Epoch, Voting ends in, Weekly emissions (SKAI)) — the code surfaces epoch and voting power but not as that tile grid.

Real screen — the populated state. Built: the gauges table with per-gauge rows and an epoch badge (GaugeWeightsTable), voting power, and the Bribe rewards claim card. MISSING: the "All gauges" filter select, and the frame's per-row Caps column. ★ THE DONUT IS NOT A SPEC. The frame's left panel is a ring chart legended by Epoch #0 / #1 / #2 / Others with SKAI amounts, but its centre label literally reads "Net worth $289.01 +1.99%" — it is the wallet net-worth donut dropped in as a placeholder, so its geometry says nothing about gauge data. Separately, the per-epoch series it implies is blocked: gauge votes are current-epoch only (useBribeClaims.ts:74-75), the same limit already recorded for 11260-123547.
